title: Essential for understanding the fine arts museum.
text: The visit to the fine arts museum in Seville was fantastic. Our guide Julio enriched the experience significantly with his historical context and detailed explanations. Very engaging and rigorous, it was like moving from a 2D visit to a 3D experience thanks to those details. We recommend it 100% for its friendliness and professionalism.

title: Maria is fantastic

title: Great tour, would absolutely recommend!
text: Julio was an excellent guide! Our tour was in English and he was very easy to understand and had lots of knowledge about the art as well as interesting history! The museum itself is beautiful with so many things on display, easy to navigate and was not too crowded. Would absolutely recommend this tour with Julio!!
author: Michelle_C

title: Very interesting
text: Patricia the guide, explained the works clearly and interestingly, providing historical context and details that help to better appreciate the art. I totally recommend this guided tour for those who want to know and understand the works and history of the museum.
author: Fernanda M

title: Art at its finest
text:
The tour guide we had was outstanding. I, myself, am an artist as was the tour guide, so the artistic process fascinates me. Luckily, as the tour guide is a fine artist, she discussed the artwork in greater depth than the average tour guide. For example, she detailed the painting process of specific artists, the types of material used for painting on, and the reason for specific colour selections. Her knowledge about the artworks and the artists was second to none, and I couldn't have asked for a better tour guide.

Each artwork, be it sculpture or painting, holds its own unique representation
author: Kirsty A

title: Fantastic tour and a beautiful gallery!
text: The tour guide was fantastic! So knowledgeable and helpful. The tour really bought the museum to life. The guide was a fine arstist herself and was able to explain not only the artists and the history of the art on display, but also the techniques used. We would strongly recommend this for anyone who is has an interest in art and history!
author: karimkB8998YK

title: Do Not Miss this Excellent Tour
text: Julio was our guide for this outstanding tour of the art. He was well informed, interesting and engaging, the time flew by. Having someone talk you through an art work takes it from slightly interesting to absolutely fascinating. Book this tour, you will not regret it.
author: kjames3

title: Great way to gain insights
text: Julio was a wonderful guide. He explained perfectly the works that he chose to highlight. His enthusiasm for Art was obvious and the time flew by. Highly recommended, we learned a lot and enjoyed it a lot
